claim: Two further performance revisions are rejected. The GPU bound revision is slower. A CPU packing gain fails its repeat trial. The quiet air-pressure overlay remains released.

cpuProof.maxProof: Both partitions compute max({0} union every arbitrary signed-i32 input). Max is associative, commutative and idempotent, so regrouping cannot alter its exact result. Neither reduction adds signed integers.
scope: CPU mocks do not compile WGSL or execute GPU work.
